title: Vietnamese Style Bun Rieu
description: A vegetarian twist on the popular Vietnamese noodle soup, Bun Rieu. This dish combines the flavors of Southeast Asia with the comfort of a warm bowl of goodness.

ingredients.name: rieu tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained and cut into small pieces

instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 5 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a large pot, combine the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and shrimp-free broth. Bring to a simmer.
Add the mushrooms and tofu to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes or until they're tender.
Add the bean sprouts to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the noodles into a bowl, then add a portion of the hot soup and toppings.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Note: You can customize the toppings to your liking, but this is a classic combination.
If you prefer a spicier soup, you can add some sliced chili peppers to the pot.
You can also add some sliced pork or chicken to the pot for added protein.
For a vegan version, replace the broth with a store-bought or homemade vegan broth.
Experiment with different types of mushrooms or vegetables to change up the flavor and texture.
